interpretation: The same saved adapter routes correctly reach a missing-input request when the required file is absent and a validated ready plan when it is supplied. Routing has no available-files inventory; planning performs this check. Requiring early clarification in the routing-only audit is a stage-specific preference, not a proven complete-application failure.
grading_policy: Preserve all original strict, application-review and early-clarification scores. Do not treat the three early-clarification mismatches as executed unsafe jobs or automatically train against them. These replay diagnostics produce no new model-accuracy score.

limitations: Routing responses were replayed, and supplied-file probes were plan-only. These checks establish application-gate behavior for these fixtures, not fresh routing reliability or correctness of the three native algorithms.
